description: The bar chart illustrates the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, specifically representing the NDCG@10 metric across different model configurations. The horizontal axis displays the categorical configurations, which lack an overall axis label, and are ordered from left to right as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical axis represents the metric values on a linear scale, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25, with numeric tick labels and corresponding horizontal grid lines at regular intervals of 0.05. The chart contains four vertical bars corresponding to each category. The first bar, labeled "Ours", is visually emphasized in orange and is the tallest in the chart, reaching an approximate value of 0.21. The remaining three bars are colored blue. The "- critiquing" bar has an approximate value of 0.19, the "- ranking" bar is at roughly 0.12, and the "- scoring" bar is the shortest, with a value of approximately 0.06. The bars are not sorted by height, but rather present the primary method first followed by its three ablated variants.
